_guide: Announcements shown as a pop-up on the homepage, once per visit, between 'from' and 'to' (both days included, YYYY-MM-DD).
Required: id (unique, e.g. steam-page-2026), from, to, title.
Optional: kicker (small line above the title), text (an empty line between paragraphs: \n\n), image, image_alt, button and link (both or neither).
image: 16:9, 1200 x 675 px, JPG up to 250 KB, keep the top right corner free for the close button. Put it in public/assets/img/overlay/ and write it as /assets/img/overlay/name.jpg.
When several announcements are active, the first one in the list is shown.

Example: { "id": "steam-page", "from": "2026-12-01", "to": "2026-12-14", "kicker": "Now on Steam", "title": "The board has approved a store page.", "text": "Add Arms Empire to your wishlist.\n\nIt costs nothing. For now.", "button": "Open Steam", "link": "https://store.steampowered.com/" }
